 Filings: Jensen Huang's charity committed $350M to rent compute from CoreWeave for its Computing Initiative for Open Science, and has already spent $108.3M   —  Former Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang's charitable foundation plans to spend $350 million renting computer time from CoreWeave Inc.
